name: humanizer
description:
Give informal writing a human voice: opinions, varied rhythm, first person,
mixed feelings. Trigger ONLY when BOTH hold. (1) The user explicitly asks:
"humanize this", "add voice", "make it sound like me", "this reads like AI",
or supplies a writing sample for voice matching. (2) The text is informal:
blog and social posts, newsletters, personal essays, marketing copy, fiction,
casual messages.
DO NOT trigger for academic or professional prose: manuscripts, theses,
proposals, survey or assessmen
